   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   231	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   295	/-- Equality of localized H⁰ generators transports canonically to the associated datum

   298	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_eq_smul_of_tensor_eq

   311	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
   312	
   313	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   314	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
   315	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
   316	irreducible curve hypotheses.
   317	-/
   318	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   319	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   320	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   321	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   322	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   323	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   324	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   325	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   326	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
   327	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   328	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   329	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   330	  D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s
   331	    (fun j q => by
   332	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   333	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   334	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

   339	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   340	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   341	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   342	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   343	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   344	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   345	    (P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange B y hsec).picClass =
   346	      (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass := by

   348	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   349	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   350	  unfold sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   351	  exact D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass s
   352	    (fun j q => by
   353	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   354	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   355	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

   375	/-- A datum `H^0` class, read as a global section of the native pushforward. -/
   376	noncomputable def pushforwardSectionOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   377	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   378	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   379	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module, ⊤) := by

   385	/-- The canonical unit-lift of a datum `H^0` class to the source of evaluation. -/
   386	noncomputable def evaluationLiftOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModulesBaseSheaf

/-!
# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus

An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
test and ties every piece of data to the input class:

* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.

No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.

The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents :
    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
  datum_class :
    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
  module_iso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
  native_pushforward_base_change :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_rank_one :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
  Scheme.moduleKSections
    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U

/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.

This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)

/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
      P.module :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/

/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.

The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
cartesian base change. -/
noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.

This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

/-! ## The datum/native-section/evaluation bridge -/

/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens)) :=
  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    isTerminalTop P.datum.sheaf y

/-! The datum-side section after coefficient extension.  This deliberately stops at the
glued cocycle sheaf; identifying it with native `Scheme.Modules` global sections is a
separate contract and is not smuggled in here. -/
noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
      (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf
    (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y))

/-- H⁰ base change transports the tied datum section to the canonical glued-section map. -/
theorem datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y =
      P.datum.sectionsMapTop B (P.datumSection y) := by
  exact P.datum.linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul B
    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing) y

/-- The linear map underlying the canonical base-changed datum-section construction. -/
noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) →ₗ[B]
      (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
  ((P.h0BaseChange B).trans
    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf)).toLinearMap

@[simp]
theorem datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap_one_tmul
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    P.datumSectionBaseChangeLinearMap B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) =
      P.datumSectionBaseChange B y := by
  rfl

   162	  simpa only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMapTop] using
   163	    sectionsMap_tower C R R' D R'' hW' hW'' s

   170	private lemma h0Equiv_val_h0BaseChange_one_tmul
   171	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   172	    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :
   173	    (((D.baseChange R').pairData.h0Equiv
   174	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   175	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   176	      (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)))
   177	      (D.datumH0BaseChange R' hH1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y))).val =
   178	    D.datumDomBaseChange R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
   179	      ((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   180	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   181	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   182	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val)) := by
   183	  letI := D.projective_sectionsInf
   184	  have hinner : ((datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y) :
   185	      LinearMap.ker ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange R')) :
   186	        R' ⊗[R] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj
   187	          (op (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀)) ×
   188	          (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁)))) =
   189	      (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   190	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   191	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   192	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val)) := by
   193	    unfold datumH0BaseChangeEquiv
   194	    rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0BaseChangeEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
   195	      LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul]
   196	    change (((LinearMap.ker (datumPair D).diff).subtype.baseChange R')
   197	      ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (D.pairData.h0Equiv
   198	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   199	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   200	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y)) : _) = _
   201	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply]
   202	  let e := (D.baseChange R').pairData.h0Equiv
   203	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   204	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   205	    (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   206	  change (e (e.symm ((RigidEngine.kerCongr
   207	      ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange R')
   208	      (datumPair (D.baseChange R')).diff
   209	      (D.datumDomBaseChange R') (D.termBaseChangeInf R')
   210	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange R' x))
   211	      (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y))))).val =
   212	    D.datumDomBaseChange R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
   213	      ((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   214	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   215	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   216	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val))
   217	  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
   218	  refine (RigidEngine.kerCongr_apply_coe _ _ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
   219	  exact congrArg (D.datumDomBaseChange R') hinner

   224	/-- On a pure tensor, the certificate's H0 comparison is comparison of the corresponding global
   225	glued section. -/
   226	theorem linearEquivZero_h0BaseChange_one_tmul
   227	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   228	    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :
   229	    Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   230	        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   231	        isTerminalTop (D.baseChange R').sheaf
   232	        (D.datumH0BaseChange R' hH1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
   233	      D.sectionsMapTop R'
   234	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   235	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   236	          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y) := by
   237	  let e := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   238	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   239	    isTerminalTop (D.baseChange R').sheaf
   240	  apply e.symm.injective
   241	  rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
   242	  apply ((D.baseChange R').pairData.h0Equiv
   243	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   244	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   245	    (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))).injective
   246	  apply Subtype.ext
   247	  unfold e
   248	  rw [h0Equiv_val_h0BaseChange_one_tmul C R R' D hH1 y]
   249	  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
   250	  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
   251	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul R',
   252	    D.termBaseChange₀_tmul R', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul R', one_smul]
   253	  rw [one_smul]
   254	  simp only
   255	  apply Prod.ext
   256	  · change D.sectionsMap R'
   257	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₀)
   258	        (gluedRes R D.pieces D.unit
   259	          (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   260	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   261	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   262	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)) =
   263	      gluedRes R' (D.baseChange R').pieces (D.baseChange R').unit
   264	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   265	        (D.sectionsMapTop R'
   266	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   267	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   268	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y))
   269	    convert
   270	      (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap R'
   271	        (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   272	        (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top])
   273	        (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₀)
   274	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   275	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   276	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   277	          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)).symm using 1
   278	    rfl
   279	  · change D.sectionsMap R'
   280	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₁)
   281	        (gluedRes R D.pieces D.unit
   282	          (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   283	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   284	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   285	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)) =
   286	      gluedRes R' (D.baseChange R').pieces (D.baseChange R').unit
   287	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   288	        (D.sectionsMapTop R'
   289	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   290	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   291	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y))
   292	    convert
   293	      (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap R'
   294	        (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   295	        (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top])
   296	        (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₁)
   297	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   298	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   299	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   300	          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)).symm using 1
   301	    rfl

   307	/-- The canonical two-step H0 comparison, including reassociation of tensor products and
   308	transport along the canonical equality of the two base-changed cocycle data. -/
   309	noncomputable def h0BaseChangeTwoStep
   310	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   311	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   312	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R''] :
   313	    R'' ⊗[R] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[R'']
   314	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange R'').sheaf 0 :=
   315	  let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   316	    D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   317	  ((((TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R R' R'' R''
   318	      (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)).symm.trans
   319	      (LinearEquiv.baseChange R' R'' _ _ (P.h0BaseChange R'))).trans
   320	      ((P.scalarExtension R').h0BaseChange R'')).trans
   321	      (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
   322	        (eqToIso (congrArg
   323	          (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi => E.sheaf) hD)) 0))
   324

   326	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   327	set_option maxRecDepth 4000 in
   328	/-- Direct and iterated canonical H0 base change agree along every affine coefficient tower. -/
   329	theorem h0BaseChange_tower
   330	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   331	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   332	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R''] :
   333	    P.h0BaseChange R'' = h0BaseChangeTwoStep C R R' D P R'' := by
   334	  letI : Module R (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange R'').sheaf 0) :=
   335	    Module.compHom _ (algebraMap R R'')
   336	  letI : IsScalarTower R R'' (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange R'').sheaf 0) :=
   337	    IsScalarTower.of_compHom R R'' _
   338	  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
   339	  apply LinearMap.restrictScalars_injective R
   340	  apply TensorProduct.ext'
   341	  intro r'' y
   342	  have hone : P.h0BaseChange R'' ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
   343	      h0BaseChangeTwoStep C R R' D P R'' ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R] y) := by
   344	    let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   345	      D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   346	    let hH1 := (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing
   347	    let hH1' := (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff (D.baseChange R')).mpr
   348	      (P.scalarExtension R').h1_vanishing
   349	    simp only [h0BaseChangeTwoStep, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
   350	      TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul]
   351	    symm
   352	    change Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
   353	          (eqToIso (congrArg
   354	            (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi => E.sheaf) hD)) 0
   355	          ((P.scalarExtension R').h0BaseChange R''
   356	            (LinearEquiv.baseChange R' R'' _ _ (P.h0BaseChange R')
   357	              ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R'] ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y)))) =
   358	        P.h0BaseChange R'' ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R] y)
   359	    apply (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   360	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R'' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   361	      isTerminalTop (D.baseChange R'').sheaf).injective
   362	    rw [linearEquivZero_mapEquiv_eq_cast C hD]
   363	    rw [LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul]
   364	    change cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
   365	        ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
   366	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   367	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R'' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   368	          isTerminalTop ((D.baseChange R').baseChange R'').sheaf
   369	          ((D.baseChange R').datumH0BaseChange R'' hH1'
   370	            ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R'] (D.datumH0BaseChange R' hH1
   371	              ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y))))) =
   372	      Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   373	        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R'' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   374	        isTerminalTop (D.baseChange R'').sheaf
   375	        (D.datumH0BaseChange R'' hH1 ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R] y))
   376	    rw [linearEquivZero_h0BaseChange_one_tmul C R' R'' (D.baseChange R') hH1']
   377	    rw [linearEquivZero_h0BaseChange_one_tmul C R R' D hH1]
   378	    rw [linearEquivZero_h0BaseChange_one_tmul C R R'' D hH1]
   379	    exact sectionsMapTop_tower C R R' D R''
   380	      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   381	        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   382	        isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)
   383	  have hr : (r'' ⊗ₜ[R] y : R'' ⊗[R] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) =
   384	      r'' • ((1 : R'') ⊗ₜ[R] y) := by
   385	    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
   386	  rw [hr]
   387	  simp only [LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, map_smul]
   388	  exact congrArg (r'' • ·) hone
